title: Carrier Revival in Long Trapped-Ion Chains
summary: For a single trapped ion, the excitation spectrum of a narrow optical transition consists of a Doppler- and recoil-free carrier accompanied by motional sidebands, which are equally spaced by the trap secular frequency and lie under a Doppler-broadened envelope that is shifted by the photon recoil. Outside the Lamb-Dicke regime, the large photon recoil distributes the line strength across many sidebands and suppresses excitation of the carrier. With multiple ions, the motional spectrum becomes dense, and the carrier is further weakened. Here, we predict a counterintuitive revival effect:…
